question: Should the dashboard agent-status widget land now as a `sessions.list`-backed builtin, or should this issue wait for the richer `sessions.activity.*` Gateway contract before it is considered solved?
rationale: The requested widget is coherent and valuable, but choosing the permanent source of truth for current task, progress, attention, and cross-agent activity is a product/API sequencing decision that automation cannot safely make.

options.title: Review the staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the current candidate while requiring its proof, storage, security, dependency, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for the activity contract
options.body: Keep this issue open until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127 lands a richer per-session activity API, then implement the widget against that stable contract.

options.title: Fold unique requirements into the roadmap
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 own dashboard sequencing only if this issue's status/current-task/progress requirements are preserved there.

recommendation.title: Review the staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the current candidate while requiring its proof, storage, security, dependency, and merge blockers to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab and sessions UI surfaces involved in accepting this dashboard product direction.
